attributes.name: Gribbet
attributes.powers:
If another character would fail a check to acquire a boon, discard this card to add 1d4+1 to the result, if that character now succeeds at the check, you acquire the boon.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, you may evade the first card you encounter; if you do, examine the top 2 cards of your location deck.
